Bengal MPs Raise Mosque Loudspeaker Issue with Home Minister Amit Shah

Three Members of Parliament from West Bengal, identified as Khalilur Rahaman, Yusuf Pathan, and Abu Taher Khan, met with Union Home Minister Amit Shah. The MPs reportedly raised concerns regarding the removal of loudspeakers from mosques and the deletion of certain names from voter lists. One report states that 1279 mosques in Bengal had their loudspeakers removed. The MPs sought intervention from Amit Shah on these matters.
